claim_boundary: Registry and navigation only. Presence, CI success or packaging does not validate RLL as a physical theory.

mechanisms.description: Canonical real-data materialization, validation and artifact packaging workflow.
allowed_claims: listed repository evidence was located and hashed
blocked_claims: RLL is superior to LCDM, wCDM or CPL

required_evidence: full official cross-block covariance where available
independent verification of source transcription and checksums
vector model predictions in the emitted observable order
fit-level integration tests proving covariance use
uncertainties.F_next: Integrate the emitted block matrix into an isolated DESI DR2 vector-likelihood adapter, preserving the existing real-fit path until regression and independent source-verification gates pass.

mechanisms.description: Claim-bounded reconstruction and validation of repository-declared DESI DR2 BAO 2x2 covariance blocks and their ordered block-diagonal matrix.
allowed_claims: repository-declared paired covariance blocks were reconstructed and checked
the emitted block matrix changes a deterministic synthetic quadratic-form diagnostic
blocked_claims: a full official DESI joint covariance was ingested
the covariance audit is a cosmological fit
the audit confirms or favors RLL

mechanisms.description: Claim-bounded numerical diagnostics for anomaly detection, toroidal Fourier checks and a BIC-derived Bayes proxy.
allowed_claims: Tier 1 numerical diagnostics executed under their declared inputs
blocked_claims: a theorem was proved by CI
the BIC proxy is equivalent to nested sampling
an anomaly detector establishes new physics

required_evidence: clean-environment reproduction by an independent reviewer
receipt with commit, environment and checksums
uncertainties.F_next: Export the Tier 1 artifact and request an independent clean-room reproduction.

mechanisms.description: Central responsibility map connecting claims, evidence locations and unresolved provenance questions.
allowed_claims: the repository declares a traceability route for listed claims
blocked_claims: the map itself proves every referenced claim

blocking_claims: complete v1 image and CSV ancestry established
required_evidence: inventory of tag and DOI files
paths, hashes and timestamps for early images and CSV files
uncertainties.F_next: Materialize the official DOI/Zenodo snapshot and compare it against the immutable tag inventory by path, hash and role.

required_evidence: output hash tied to a repository commit
uncertainties.F_next: Locate one physical mobile execution receipt and bind it to commit, command, environment and output hash.
Prepare a bounded review package containing claims, evidence, contradictions and reproducible commands.

mechanisms.description: Immutable Git-tag inventory of RLL v1.0.0 images and CSV blobs with object identifiers and SHA-256.
allowed_claims: the selected Git tag image and CSV blobs were inventoried and hashed
blocked_claims: the Git tag inventory proves DOI equivalence
the inventoried artifacts validate RLL scientifically

mechanisms.description: Machine-readable catalog of textual result artifacts, generators and reproduction commands.
allowed_claims: listed textual artifacts have declared locations and reproduction metadata

blocking_claims: all historical results are reproducible from one canonical code path
required_evidence: canonical generator script for each historical artifact
uncertainties.F_next: Select one historical result without a canonical generator and reconstruct its minimal reproducible path.
